matrix.enforcement_mechanism: CaseService.update_case checks ALLOWED_CASE_TRANSITIONS map
CaseService.update_case checks ALLOWED_CASE_TRANSITIONS map
CaseService.update_case raises ValidationError if new_status != CLOSED
CaseService.update_case raises ValidationError if new_status != CANCELLED

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: YES in CaseService.update_case; however, CaseWorkflowService._check_case_active_for_mutations only checks tasks/deadlines. Re-opening from CLOSED/CANCELLED raises ValidationError.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: YES. Only ADMIN or OWNER/LAWYER participant with modification permissions can call update_case.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: NO, owner or assigned lawyer with non-VIEWER role can transition case status.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: NO prerequisite data validation (e.g. no check that all tasks/hearings are completed before closing).
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: YES. Can jump directly from OPEN to CLOSED without ever entering IN_PROGRESS.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: NO. Closed/cancelled cases cannot be reopened via update_case.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: PARTIAL DEFECT (BL-FIND-02). While status itself cannot be changed once CLOSED, metadata (title, description), participants (add/remove), and notes can still be modified on CLOSED cases.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: NO locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE is not used in update_case), concurrent requests could race.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: YES. Direct updates in scripts or routers can update Case.status without audit triggers.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Explicit if consultation.status != REQUESTED check in accept/reject/schedule
Payment webhook transitions to PAID, schedule_consultation allows transition to SCHEDULED
Meeting start/complete and cancel methods enforce state requirements
complete_consultation verifies active or scheduled meeting before completing
cancel_consultation rejects COMPLETED, BUT CommercialService.process_refund unconditionally mutates COMPLETED -> CANCELLED (BL-FIND-04)
cancel_consultation is idempotent; cannot reschedule cancelled consultation

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: YES in consultation_service methods, EXCEPT CommercialService.process_refund which resets COMPLETED to CANCELLED upon full refund (BL-FIND-04).
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: YES. accept/reject can only be called by the assigned lawyer; cancellation allowed by client, lawyer, or admin; completion by lawyer or admin.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: YES. _authorize_consultation_access ensures actor is either client, assigned lawyer, or admin.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: YES. Scheduling requires selected slot; completion requires meeting ended_at or active meeting; payment requires commercial transaction.
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: YES. Direct scheduling without separate ACCEPTED step occurs in instant booking flow.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: CRITICAL DEFECT (BL-FIND-04). Terminal COMPLETED state can be reversed to CANCELLED via CommercialService.process_refund.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: YES (BL-FIND-04). Terminal COMPLETED can be overwritten to CANCELLED.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: YES for consultation_service operations which execute _get_consultation(for_update=True); NO for commercial_service process_refund which locks transaction but not consultation.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: YES. Webhooks and router endpoints can directly query and update consultation status.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: capture_consultation_payment checks status in (PENDING, AUTHORIZED)
process_refund checks txn.status in (CAPTURED, AUTHORIZED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED)
process_refund accumulates prior_refunds and computes remaining_refundable
process_refund raises AppException(TRANSACTION_ALREADY_REFUNDED) if remaining_refundable <= 0 or status == REFUNDED

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: YES. Double refunds and refunds exceeding gross amount are rejected.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: YES. Refunds require ADMIN or platform authority or system cancellation.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: NO, refunds are processed by platform on behalf of actors.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: YES. Refund requires positive remaining_refundable and successful prior capture.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: NO. REFUNDED transactions cannot be refunded again.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: YES. Uses get_transaction(for_update=True) and sums RefundRecord within transaction.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: NO router bypass observed for commercial transactions; routed through CommercialService.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: submit_verification transitions from DRAFT to PENDING after validating required docs
Admin review start transitions to UNDER_REVIEW
approve_verification and reject_verification methods enforce transition rules
revoke_verification method transitions APPROVED to REVOKED; re-approval rejected
resubmit_verification allows new submission after rejection

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: YES. Direct DRAFT->APPROVED is prevented; review events are logged.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: YES. Only ADMIN can approve/reject/revoke; lawyer can submit/resubmit.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: YES. Lawyer can only submit their own verification record.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: YES. Requires enrollment_number, bar_council_name, state_bar_council, identity and bar cert documents.
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: NO skipping of review step permitted in service.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: YES. Rejection can be reversed through resubmission.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: REVOKED is terminal and revokes LawyerProfile.verification_status to REVOKED.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: Uses database transaction and review event audit trail; admin approval runs synchronously.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: YES. Case participant addition (BL-FIND-01) bypasses verification checks entirely, granting unverified lawyers access to confidential case files.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: DocumentProcessor._process_document_internal transitions to PROCESSING on start
DocumentProcessor marks READY upon successful text extraction and chunking
Document is terminal and searchable via pgvector embeddings

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: Failure status updates set error_message and log error.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: NO. Processing is managed by background workers and processor jobs.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: Upload requires case/user ownership; processing is automated.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: Requires valid S3/MinIO storage path and passing malware scan (DocumentSecurityStatus.SAFE).
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: NO. Cannot jump directly from PENDING to READY without text extraction and chunking.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: Re-processing creates a new DocumentVersion or re-enqueues processing job.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: Re-processing updates status back to PROCESSING.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: Worker queue uses SKIP LOCKED or single processor invocation per document version.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: Router endpoints do not directly mutate processing_status.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: process_webhook_event checks existing record before dispatch
Completes to PROCESSED on handler success or FAILED on exception
Idempotent short-circuit returns existing PROCESSED event immediately
Reconciliation job re-attempts FAILED events up to max retry threshold

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: Duplicate deliveries of PROCESSED events are immediately acknowledged with HTTP 200 without re-execution.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: NO. Inbound Stripe webhook endpoint authenticated via HMAC-SHA256 signature.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: Signature verification against stripe webhook secret.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: Requires valid Stripe Event JSON and event_id.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: PROCESSED events are never reversed to FAILED.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: Database uniqueness constraint on stripe_event_id and row locking prevent race conditions.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: Email verification marks user VERIFIED and ACTIVE
LifecycleService enforces administrative transition rules
Reactivation requires admin action; authentication is blocked
Deactivation revokes all active refresh tokens and marks account inactive

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: SUSPENDED users cannot log in or refresh tokens; DEACTIVATED users are permanently disabled.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: Suspension, restriction, and deactivation require ADMIN role.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: Self-deactivation allowed for account owners; suspension requires ADMIN.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: Registration requires unique email and hashed password.
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: Google OAuth registration skips REGISTERED directly to ACTIVE.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: SUSPENDED can be reversed to ACTIVE by administrator.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: Session revocation is executed synchronously with status changes.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: CaseWorkflowService verifies active case before task state changes
complete_task sets completed_at and transitions status
completed tasks cannot be completed again

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: Modifying tasks on closed/cancelled cases raises BusinessRuleError.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: Task management requires case participant with non-VIEWER role.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: Assignee or case owner can complete tasks.
determination_analysis.6_requires_prerequisite_data: Requires active parent case and valid case_id.
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: Can transition directly from PENDING to COMPLETED without IN_PROGRESS.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: Completed tasks cannot be reopened via standard workflow endpoints.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: COMPLETED tasks record completed_at and are sealed.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: Task updates via direct router queries could bypass parent case closed checks.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: complete_hearing checks case active and status == SCHEDULED
Cannot complete already completed hearing

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: Cannot complete hearing on a closed or cancelled case.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: Requires case participant with OWNER or LAWYER role.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: Outcomes and notes recorded upon completion.

matrix.enforcement_mechanism: complete_upload validates sha256 and transitions to ACTIVE
delete_evidence verifies legal hold is not active before marking DELETED
restore_evidence transitions ARCHIVED back to ACTIVE
Soft-deleted evidence is omitted from active queries (except DB-FIND-02 leakage sites)

determination_analysis.3_invalid_transitions_rejected: Cannot delete evidence under legal hold (is_legal_hold == True). Cannot complete upload without valid SHA256.
determination_analysis.4_role_dependent: OWNER, LAWYER, or ADMIN can manage evidence; legal hold requires OWNER/ADMIN.
determination_analysis.5_requires_ownership: Requires case participation and appropriate evidence access grant.
determination_analysis.7_can_be_skipped: Cannot become ACTIVE without completing staged upload.
determination_analysis.8_can_be_reversed: ARCHIVED can be restored to ACTIVE; DELETED cannot be restored.
determination_analysis.9_terminal_states_modifiable: DELETED evidence cannot be shared or downloaded.
determination_analysis.10_concurrent_transitions_safe: Chain of custody logging records actor and timestamp sequentially.
determination_analysis.11_direct_db_bypass: Uploading new evidence does not check if parent case is CLOSED (BL-FIND-02).
